Guidance/promo/tuition registers, meta announcements (grade thresholds/timetables/results/graduations/lives), the edutainment-shorts register, the Anna-university GE8291 EVS register (0 binds — the false-density call of record), the UK-GCSE Edexcel register, CIE AS/A Level IT 9626, the O-Level register (the disclosed 4037/2281/7707/5090/7115 duals exempt, the P14 spine-code precedence generalized), the IAL/CIE maths 9709 bare-walkthrough class (ANCHOR-GRANULARITY section 6, P9 precedent) and out-of-spine boards (AQA/OCR/IB) are excluded and ledgered as skips. Rejected/unrouted videos stay out of videos[]. P19 disclosed amendments: the tokenizer stems to singular so plural-form title tokens agree with spine tokens (disclosed, consistent on both sides of the df tables); split_fields gains the dash-run separator (the "Biology- {topic}" forms); the honest register re-adjudications of record: ginger-mathematician's "4MA1 x159" gate read was the generic "iGCSE Maths" form — the channel is CIE-branded so the register of record is 0580/0607/0606 (the 4MA1 deficits stay open, re-sweepable); benzakademi's "8291 x13" was the Anna-university GE8291 EVS register (0 binds); academic-plus's "A-Level Business" family was board-agnostic (only explicit 9609/4BS1 titles bind).
